subject: general
question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e56e2bc6ee5567235530be7d7d98400b1dfed00ec056c762cc3a48e34007eb9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second figure is formed by taking the horizontal mirror image (left-to-right reflection) of the first figure.

The first pair:

The black flag-like shape on the left shifts to the right after reflection.

The white triangle near the center reverses its direction.

The outward line on the right shifts to the left side.

The second pair:

The outward line on the left shifts to the right side.

The black flag-like shape on the right shifts to the left after reflection.

The white triangle pointing right reverses to point left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf0c6942a69b36758437267799a832bcc0f74ccd3ebad9d9692c8d80a2e98134.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
